fr.sorbonne_u.cps.pubsub.interfaces

Interface PublicationSubscriptionUserI


  • public interface PublicationSubscriptionUserI
    The interface PublicationSubscriptionUserI declares the signatures of methods to be implemented by a publication/subscription system user plug-in.

    Description

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2026-01-20

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
